title: 12 Day Bwindi and Ruhija Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Bwindi Birding Safari: 12 Wonderful Days in Uganda's Forests
rank_math_desc: Bwindi birding safari for 12 days: Mabamba, Lake Mburo, four nights at Ruhija, Buhoma, Queen Elizabeth and Kibale. Price on request.
post_content: This Bwindi birding safari gives you four nights at Ruhija and two at Buhoma, the most time we offer in Uganda's richest forest.
overview:
This Bwindi birding safari is for birders who want depth rather than distance. Six nights in and around Bwindi Impenetrable National Park give you the best possible chance at the Albertine Rift endemics.

The trip starts with the shoebill at Mabamba and the savannah of Lake Mburo, and ends with Queen Elizabeth National Park and the forest of Kibale.

Why choose this Bwindi birding safari?

  • Ruhija: four nights for Mubwindi Swamp, the bamboo zone and African green broadbill.
  • Buhoma: two nights on the main trail for Neumann's warbler and equatorial akalat.
  • Lake Mburo: African finfoot and savannah birds by boat and on foot.
  • Kibale and Bigodi: green-breasted pitta and an optional chimpanzee trek.

Where you stay

Sophie's Hotel in Entebbe, Mantana Tented Camp, Trekker's Tavern Cottages at Ruhija, Engagi Lodge at Buhoma, Savannah Resort near Queen Elizabeth, Primate Lodge and Tooro Resort, or similar.

Best time for a Bwindi birding safari

Bwindi can be birded all year. June to August and December to February are drier and trails are easier. March to May and October to November bring rain but very active birds.

Plan your trek with our Bwindi gorilla trekking guide, see our gorilla trekking safaris, or browse all birding safaris. The Uganda Wildlife Authority manages Bwindi and its permits.

How much does the Bwindi birding safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com or send the enquiry form on this page, and we will share a detailed quote for your dates.
highlights: Four nights at Ruhija for Mubwindi Swamp and the bamboo zone
African green broadbill and other Albertine Rift endemics
Shoebill at Mabamba and African finfoot at Lake Mburo
Optional gorilla trek and chimpanzee tracking

faq.q: Why spend so long in Bwindi?
faq.a: Bwindi holds most of Uganda's Albertine Rift endemics, and many are shy. More time means better chances at birds like African green broadbill.

faq.q: Is gorilla trekking included in the Bwindi birding safari?
faq.a: It is optional. We can book a gorilla permit for day 5 if you want to trek.
Sophie's Hotel, Mantana Tented Camp, Trekker's Tavern Cottages, Engagi Lodge, Savannah Resort, Primate Lodge and Tooro Resort, or similar.

faq.q: How hard is the Mubwindi Swamp trail?
faq.a: It drops about 300 m over 4 km and must be climbed back up. It is steep but manageable at a slow pace.
It is optional on day 11 and can be added.

faq.q: What should I wear in the forest?
faq.a: Long trousers, waterproof boots, a rain jacket and gloves for grabbing vegetation.

faq.q: Can I see the shoebill on this trip?
faq.a: Yes, Mabamba Swamp on day 2 is one of the best shoebill sites in Uganda.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Evening arrival and transfer to Sophie's Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Mabamba to Lake Mburo
itinerary.content: Boat trip at Mabamba for the shoebill, then drive to Lake Mburo for an evening game drive. Overnight at Mantana Tented Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Ruhija
itinerary.content: Morning savannah birding and a boat ride for African finfoot, then drive to Ruhija. Overnight at Trekker's Tavern Cottages.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Mubwindi Swamp
itinerary.content: A full day on the trail to Mubwindi Swamp for African green broadbill and Grauer's rush warbler.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Gorilla trek or forest birding
itinerary.content: Optional gorilla trek, or forest birding along the mine trail for regal sunbird and antpeckers.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Ruhija bamboo zone
itinerary.content: Search the bamboo for handsome francolin and Rwenzori batis, with afternoon birding near camp.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Ruhija to Buhoma via the Neck
itinerary.content: Bird the Neck on the way to Buhoma. Overnight at Engagi Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Buhoma main trail
itinerary.content: A full day on the main trail for owlets, cuckoos and forest warblers.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Buhoma to Queen Elizabeth via Ishasha
itinerary.content: Drive north through Ishasha, looking for tree-climbing lions. Overnight at Savannah Resort.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Kibale
itinerary.content: Birding along the way to Primate Lodge near Kibale.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Kibale and Bigodi Wetland
itinerary.content: Optional chimpanzee trek and forest birding, then a walk in Bigodi Wetland. Overnight at Tooro Resort in Fort Portal.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Kibale to Entebbe
itinerary.content: Morning forest birding west of Fort Portal, then drive to Entebbe for your flight.
